name: Block Tycoon ⛏️ [OVERCLOCKING] ⚡⚙️
desc:
Create your own Tycoon that generates many different items including: Blocks, Trees, Crops, and more!
Sell them to make money so you can build crazy bases and ever crazier farms!
The only limit is your imagination!
Good luck!

Build ⛏️
Farm 🚜
EARN CASH 💰💰💰

Did you like the game? Then please leave a Like (👍) and Favorite(🌟) . Thanks!

Q - Drop Item
Q Hold - Drop Item Stack
Mouse Middle Click - Select Block
